clips.title: The story
paras: On Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, Rahauro sends Horde fighters against threats beneath Orgrimmar. He serves Magatha Grimtotem, coordinating the response to troggs in Ragefire Chasm and the search for a fallen agent’s possessions.

Rahauro attends Magatha Grimtotem on the high terrace of Elder Rise. He speaks and acts for the elder crone, who relies on trusted servants to recruit others. When wild creatures swarm beneath the orcish capital, Rahauro handles the arrangements and sends Horde mercenaries to face them.

Troggs in the caverns of Ragefire Chasm rejected Magatha’s attempt to make peace. Her envoys went below Orgrimmar to parley, but the troggs attacked and killed them. Magatha sees the creatures as a threat to the Horde, and Rahauro sends champions into the caverns to thin their numbers and learn their strength.
